definitions.explanation: An expression of congratulation for achievements, special occasions, or celebrations. The polite form is おめでとうございます.

examples.japanese: {誕生日|たんじょうび}おめでとう！
{合格|ごうかく}おめでとうございます。
あけましておめでとうございます。
{結婚|けっこん}おめでとうございます。お{幸|しあわ}せに。
examples.english: Congratulations on your wedding. Best wishes for your happiness.

examples.japanese: {卒業|そつぎょう}おめでとう！これからも{頑張|がんば}ってね。
examples.english: Congratulations on your graduation! Keep doing your best.

notes: おめでとう is used for celebrations and congratulations. The polite form おめでとうございます is used in formal situations. Common uses include birthdays, New Year, weddings, graduation, and passing exams. The word comes from the adjective めでたい (auspicious, happy).
